messages:
Ava (sales): Quick ask — need to provision POC for AcmeCorp. Requirements: Hosted API keys for dev, short Dedicated pool for 5k req/day load test, Private/VPC peering for staging, answers to security questionnaire. Need pricing and timeline by EOD tomorrow. Who can own?

Marco (solutions): I'll coordinate. Quick Qs: do they need token-level logs? If so, Dedicated/Private only. Hosted can't do token-level retention.

Sam (eng-infra): Hosted API keys: 1 biz day. Dedicated pool request: runbook below, expect ~3-5 biz days for capacity + infra.

Sam (eng-infra): ```
# Dedicated pool request (internal CLI)
redwood infra allocate-pool --project acmecorp --tier dedicated --gpus a40 --min-replicas 2 --max-replicas 4 --duration 14d
```

Sam (eng-infra): VPC peering requires customer's network contact + IP ranges + support ticket. Timeline 7-10 biz days. Need completed Network section of vendor SOW.

Jess (security): We'll need completed security questionnaire + SOC2 report. If they want tenant isolation + KMS, route to Private. Happy to take the questionnaire — drop it here and I'll fill.

Anya (sales-eng): Pricing estimate for Dedicated POC: rough calc: $600/day for pool (gpus + infra) + $0.02/token if heavy. I'll formalize.

Ava (sales): Thanks. Can someone create a checklist we can attach to the deal? Requirements: owner, timelines, cost placeholder, ship items (keys, dedicated, peering, SQA), acceptance criteria.

Marco (solutions): I'll create a short onboarding checklist and attach to the deal. I'll ping when ready. Also creating runbook ticket: #POC-5423

deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-5423 — Dedicated pool provisioning. Assignee: Marco. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-5423

Sam (eng-infra): Owner: Marco. I'll prep infra template and credentials rotation docs. Owners: Marco (coord), Sam (infra), Jess (security), Anya (eng). Timeline: Hosted keys 1d, Dedicated 3-5d, VPC 7-10d.

Ava (sales): Perfect — please confirm cost estimate by noon. :thumbsup:

Anya (sales-eng): Confirmed I'll send preliminary estimate and add margin. Also asking legal for standard MSA addendum for POC.

Jess (security): I'll add notes on data retention and logs, will include minimum controls.

Marco (solutions): Checklist draft (short):
- Owner
- Customer network contact
- Hosted API keys issued
- Dedicated pool request submitted
- VPC peering ticket opened
- Security questionnaire completed
- Cost estimate + billing contact
- Acceptance tests (latency, concurrency, quality)
I'll attach to ticket POC-5423.

Ava (sales): Great — closing loop. If anything blocks, mark blockers in ticket. Thanks all.
